title: Mia's diary says she can read minds, then home tests during COVID

tellings.quote: diary and in her diary she said I can read my parents Minds she wrote in her diary that she can read everybody's mind

plain: A girl named Mia in Monterrey, Mexico, wrote in her diary that she could read her parents' minds, and in fact everybody's, and during COVID she was tested at home. The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made the Telepathy Tapes documentary about children said to read minds, tells Michels this as the story came to her, with Diane Powell, a psychiatrist who studies such cases, also named. If true, it would mean a child can know what others are thinking.
